advisory-board-design.name: advisory-board-design
advisory-board-design.summary: Design and run an advisory board that produces advice rather than agreement — charter, questions, advisor selection, fair market value, discussion design, and output that changes a decision.

capability-detection.name: capability-detection
capability-detection.summary: Work out what this runtime can actually do before promising a deliverable, and degrade visibly rather than failing.

citation-integrity.name: citation-integrity
citation-integrity.summary: Check that every factual claim traces to a real, retrievable source that actually says what it is cited for.

clinical-trials-search.name: clinical-trials-search
clinical-trials-search.summary: Search ClinicalTrials.gov via the v2 API to map the trial landscape — what is running, by whom, in which populations, with what endpoints, and what is about to read out.

competitive-intelligence.name: competitive-intelligence
competitive-intelligence.summary: Track and interpret competitor scientific activity continuously — pipeline movement, publication patterns, evidence strategy, regulatory milestones and positioning shifts, and what they signal.

congress-abstract-and-poster.name: congress-abstract-and-poster
congress-abstract-and-poster.summary: Write congress abstracts that fit the submission rules and build the posters that follow them.

congress-intelligence.name: congress-intelligence
congress-intelligence.summary: Analyse what changed at a medical congress and what the organisation should do about it — not summarise what was presented.

consulting-grade-design.name: consulting-grade-design
consulting-grade-design.summary: The shared visual language every generated deliverable follows — palette, typography, chart furniture, layout and image use — so a deck, PDF, HTML report or figure leaves looking like it came from a top-tier advisory firm.

data-connection.name: data-connection
data-connection.summary: Connect Medical Affairs work to available data using authorized connectors, exported files or read-only database queries.

data-visualization-for-medical.name: data-visualization-for-medical
data-visualization-for-medical.summary: Produce clinical trial figures that are honest and interpretable — Kaplan- Meier curves with numbers at risk, forest plots, waterfall and spider plots, adverse event figures, PRISMA flow diagrams.

deliverable-quality-review.name: deliverable-quality-review
deliverable-quality-review.summary: Red-team your own Medical Affairs deliverable before anyone else sees it.

diagram-and-schema.name: diagram-and-schema
diagram-and-schema.summary: Draw the diagrams Medical Affairs actually needs — treatment pathways, study schemas, PRISMA flow diagrams, patient journeys, evidence maps, decision trees, mechanism-of-action schematics, and governance flows.

document-ingestion.name: document-ingestion
document-ingestion.summary: Read documents someone has given you — PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, CSV.

evidence-appraisal.name: evidence-appraisal
evidence-appraisal.summary: Critically appraise clinical evidence the way an experienced Medical Affairs scientist does — before summarising, citing or building strategy on it.

evidence-gap-analysis.name: evidence-gap-analysis
evidence-gap-analysis.summary: Identify what we still do not know, decide which gaps are worth closing, and propose how.

evidence-synthesis.name: evidence-synthesis
evidence-synthesis.summary: Turn a body of clinical evidence into a defensible narrative that states what the totality supports, what it does not, and where it disagrees with itself.

executive-briefing.name: executive-briefing
executive-briefing.summary: Distil any body of Medical Affairs work into the two-page brief or ten-slide read a leadership team actually absorbs — situation, what changed, what it means, what to decide, by when.

field-insight-synthesis.name: field-insight-synthesis
field-insight-synthesis.summary: Turn a body of field medical observations into insights leadership can act on.

field-medical-planning.name: field-medical-planning
field-medical-planning.summary: Plan the field medical function over a cycle — territory and account prioritisation, MSL objectives, engagement planning across a stakeholder map, capacity modelling, and the metrics that describe scientific impact rather than activity volume.

guideline-engagement.name: guideline-engagement
guideline-engagement.summary: Understand and engage with clinical practice guideline development — committee cycles, what evidence a guideline body will accept, whether current evidence could support inclusion, and planning against timelines far longer than a medical plan.

hcp-discovery-and-access.name: hcp-discovery-and-access
hcp-discovery-and-access.summary: Identify relevant HCPs and ethical institutional access routes for scientific engagement.

insight-generation.name: insight-generation
insight-generation.summary: Turn raw observations into insights that change a decision.

integrated-evidence-plan.name: integrated-evidence-plan
integrated-evidence-plan.summary: Build the cross-functional evidence plan for an asset — every study, analysis and publication across clinical development, Medical Affairs, HEOR and market access, sequenced against the decisions and milestones each has to serve.

interactive-html-report.name: interactive-html-report
interactive-html-report.summary: Build a self-contained HTML report that opens in any browser with no dependencies — evidence dashboards, insight reports with filterable tables, congress readouts, competitive landscapes, evidence gap trackers.

investigator-initiated-study-review.name: investigator-initiated-study-review
investigator-initiated-study-review.summary: Evaluate and govern investigator-initiated study proposals — IIS, ISR, IIT, investigator-sponsored research.

kol-engagement-brief.name: kol-engagement-brief
kol-engagement-brief.summary: Prepare an MSL or medical lead for a specific scientific exchange with a named external expert.

launch-field-training.name: launch-field-training
launch-field-training.summary: Design the training and certification that make field medical teams able to handle launch conversations — the data, its limitations, the questions nobody can answer yet, unsolicited off-label requests and adverse event escalation — tested by scenario rather than recall.

launch-medical-readiness.name: launch-medical-readiness
launch-medical-readiness.summary: Assess whether Medical Affairs is actually ready for a launch, label expansion or major data readout — and say plainly where it is not.

launch-timeline-and-governance.name: launch-timeline-and-governance
launch-timeline-and-governance.summary: Build the Medical Affairs launch critical path and the governance that runs it — workback from the decision date, dependencies on label wording and publication, gate criteria written before the gate, named owners, and what moves when the date moves.

library-menu.name: library-menu
library-menu.summary: Explain what this entire library can do and render the visual menu card that shows it — every skill grouped by the job it serves, as prose, a table or an SVG/PNG infographic for a README, a slide or a stakeholder walkthrough.

literature-surveillance.name: literature-surveillance
literature-surveillance.summary: Run ongoing literature and evidence surveillance — a repeatable watch on a topic, product, class or competitor that reports what is NEW since the last cycle and what it changes, rather than a one-off search.

medical-affairs-foundations.name: medical-affairs-foundations
medical-affairs-foundations.summary: The operating principles, compliance boundaries and safety obligations that govern all Medical Affairs work.

medical-affairs-metrics.name: medical-affairs-metrics
medical-affairs-metrics.summary: Measure whether Medical Affairs work changed anything, rather than counting how much of it happened.

medical-affairs-orchestrator.name: medical-affairs-orchestrator
medical-affairs-orchestrator.summary: Route any Medical Affairs request to the right workflow and run it end to end.

medical-content-operations.name: medical-content-operations
medical-content-operations.summary: Plan and maintain non-promotional Medical Affairs content across channels using audience needs, evidence, content inventories and engagement measures.

medical-correspondence.name: medical-correspondence
medical-correspondence.summary: Write the formal correspondence Medical Affairs sends — Dear Healthcare Professional letters, responses to investigators and institutions, agency and vendor briefs, advisory board invitations, author correspondence, and letters accompanying scientific responses.

medical-education-program.name: medical-education-program
medical-education-program.summary: Design independent medical education and company-organised scientific education — IME grant strategy, curricula, needs assessments, speaker programmes and their governance, symposia and preceptorships.

medical-information-response.name: medical-information-response
medical-information-response.summary: Draft responses to unsolicited medical enquiries from healthcare professionals, patients and payers, and build the standard response documents and FAQ library behind them.

medical-launch-plan.name: medical-launch-plan
medical-launch-plan.summary: Build the entire Medical Affairs launch plan for an upcoming asset, new indication or label expansion by running a coordinated team of digital workers — one per launch workstream, each given its own context — under a Launch Lead, with humans deciding at every gate.

medical-slide-deck.name: medical-slide-deck
medical-slide-deck.summary: Build non-promotional medical slide decks — advisory board decks, MSL scientific presentations, congress readouts, medical-to-medical (M2M) presentations, internal data reviews and training material.

medical-strategy-plan.name: medical-strategy-plan
medical-strategy-plan.summary: Build or challenge a medical plan — the scientific priorities, the choices behind them, and the activities that trace to them.

medical-terminology-mapping.name: medical-terminology-mapping
medical-terminology-mapping.summary: Resolve free-text clinical language to controlled vocabulary so insights, adverse events, conditions and interventions can be counted and compared consistently.

meeting-transcription.name: meeting-transcription
meeting-transcription.summary: Turn an audio recording or supplied transcript into reviewable Medical Affairs meeting material.

mlr-review-readiness.name: mlr-review-readiness
mlr-review-readiness.summary: Prepare Medical Affairs content for Medical/Legal/Regulatory review and pre-check it against what reviewers actually reject.

msl-administrative-operations.name: msl-administrative-operations
msl-administrative-operations.summary: Reduce repetitive MSL administration by assembling source-backed meeting packs, open-task queues, draft CRM imports, weekly summaries and coverage reports.

msl-post-call-follow-up.name: msl-post-call-follow-up
msl-post-call-follow-up.summary: Convert actual MSL engagement notes or a transcript into factual CRM-ready drafts, scientific follow-up tasks and evidence-gap records.

msl-pre-call-planning.name: msl-pre-call-planning
msl-pre-call-planning.summary: Prepare an MSL for an upcoming scientific HCP engagement using verified professional context, prior interactions, unresolved enquiries, current evidence and permitted materials.

patient-engagement-planning.name: patient-engagement-planning
patient-engagement-planning.summary: Design Medical Affairs partnerships and co-creation with patients, caregivers and patient organizations around scientific needs.

payer-value-dossier.name: payer-value-dossier
payer-value-dossier.summary: Build evidence for payers and health technology assessment bodies — AMCP format dossiers, NICE, G-BA and HAS submissions, value propositions, budget impact narratives, and responses to HTA critique.

pdf-generation.name: pdf-generation
pdf-generation.summary: Produce PDF deliverables — briefs, reports, standard response documents, one-pagers, evidence summaries, anything that must look the same for every reader and print predictably.

plain-language-summary.name: plain-language-summary
plain-language-summary.summary: Write plain language summaries of clinical research for patients and the public — trial results lay summaries, plain language summaries of publications, and patient-facing scientific material.

promotional-material-medical-review.name: promotional-material-medical-review
promotional-material-medical-review.summary: Support a qualified medical signatory reviewing commercial promotional material by assessing that every claim is scientifically accurate, substantiated by the referenced data, and fairly balanced.

public-evidence-search.name: public-evidence-search
public-evidence-search.summary: Search free public scientific sources through the bundled gateway when a task needs literature, trial records, labels, adverse-event reports or citation metadata.

pubmed-search.name: pubmed-search
pubmed-search.summary: Search PubMed properly and retrieve real, verifiable literature via the NCBI E-utilities API.

real-world-evidence-design.name: real-world-evidence-design
real-world-evidence-design.summary: Design a real-world evidence study that will survive scrutiny — target trial emulation, data source selection, the estimand, confounding control, and a protocol written and registered before the data are touched.

regulatory-label-intelligence.name: regulatory-label-intelligence
regulatory-label-intelligence.summary: Retrieve approved US label content and post-marketing safety data via openFDA, and interpret both correctly.

safety-communication.name: safety-communication
safety-communication.summary: Communicate safety information to healthcare professionals and internal audiences — new safety findings, label safety changes, emerging signals, responses to safety questions, and the decision about whether and how to communicate at all.

scientific-communication-strategy.name: scientific-communication-strategy
scientific-communication-strategy.summary: Decide what the publication and scientific communication strategy should be — which questions to answer, for which audiences, in what sequence — rather than listing papers by data availability.

scientific-manuscript.name: scientific-manuscript
scientific-manuscript.summary: Draft, structure and prepare a scientific manuscript for journal submission — primary trial reports, secondary analyses, real-world evidence papers, reviews and case reports.

scientific-platform.name: scientific-platform
scientific-platform.summary: Build or challenge the scientific platform — the core evidence-based narrative, the scientific statements it supports, the lexicon, and the communication objectives everything else derives from.

spreadsheet-analysis.name: spreadsheet-analysis
spreadsheet-analysis.summary: Analyse and produce spreadsheets — field insight exports, enquiry logs, publication trackers, evidence tables, budget allocations, congress abstract lists.

strategic-analysis.name: strategic-analysis
strategic-analysis.summary: Reason about Medical Affairs strategy rather than generating activity lists.

systematic-literature-review.name: systematic-literature-review
systematic-literature-review.summary: Run a reproducible, PRISMA-aligned systematic literature review — protocol first, documented search strategy, screening funnel with recorded exclusion reasons, structured extraction, and risk-of-bias assessment.

visual-abstract.name: visual-abstract
visual-abstract.summary: Create visual abstracts and infographics that summarise a study or a body of evidence honestly.

workshop-launcher.name: workshop-launcher
workshop-launcher.summary: Start a Medical Affairs workshop from a repository link or a simple request.

missions.title: Build the whole medical launch plan
missions.objective: Act as the Launch Lead for the selected fictional product's proposed label expansion. Build the launch facts sheet and six-month question list, staff an org chart of digital workers (one per launch workstream, each with its own context packet), run them in waves with human decision gates, integrate the joins, and finish with an independent readiness verdict that is allowed to be 'not ready'. Every gap carries a named human owner and a date.
deliverables: Integrated launch plan with org chart and workstream plans
Critical path, gate criteria and RACI
Independent readiness verdict and gap register
